privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: CanYoldaşı ("app", "we") is a community-driven mobile application for reporting, tracking stray animals and managing adoption listings in Turkey. This Privacy Policy explains how personal data collected through the app is processed, used, and shared.
privacy.s2_1Body: Name, email address and phone number are collected during registration. Passwords are stored hashed with bcrypt and are never stored or transmitted in plain text.
privacy.s2_2Body: Location data (latitude/longitude) is collected with the user's consent when reporting a stray animal or creating a listing. Background location tracking is not performed.
privacy.s2_3Body: Photos uploaded for animal reports and listings are stored on our servers. Photos are used solely for in-app purposes.
privacy.s2_4Body: Messages between users are transmitted over an encrypted connection (HTTPS/TLS) and stored in the database. Messages can only be read by the participants of the relevant conversation.
privacy.s2_5Body: Payments are processed by the Apple App Store or Google Play Store. Credit card or payment details are not stored on CanYoldaşı servers. Purchase verification is handled via RevenueCat.
privacy.s3Body:
Collected data is used for:
• Account creation and authentication
• Managing stray animal reports and adoption listings
• Messaging between users
• In-app purchase verification
• Improving service quality
• Fulfilling legal obligations
privacy.s4Body:
Your personal data is never sold or rented to third parties.

Data may only be shared in these cases:
• Service providers (RevenueCat — purchase verification)
• Legal requirements (court orders, authority requests)
• In emergencies to protect safety
privacy.s5Body:
• All communication is encrypted with HTTPS/TLS
• Passwords are stored hashed with bcrypt
• JWT tokens are short-lived (30 days)
• Password reset codes are stored SHA-256 hashed and expire after 10 minutes
privacy.s6Body:
• Account data: until account is deleted
• Animal reports: anonymized, retained indefinitely (community data)
• Adoption listings: anonymized, retained indefinitely
• Messages: access cut off when account is deleted
• Password reset tokens: after use or 10 minutes
privacy.s7Body:
Under KVKK (Personal Data Protection Law) you have the right to:
• Access your data and request a copy
• Request correction of inaccurate data
• Delete your account and all personal data (Account > Danger Zone > Delete Account)
• Object to data processing

For requests: {{contact}}
privacy.s8Body: This app is not intended for children under 13. We do not knowingly collect personal data from users under 13.
privacy.s9Body: The mobile app does not use cookies. AsyncStorage is used for session management on the web version. No ad tracking or third-party analytics tools are used.
privacy.s10Body: When this policy is updated, a notification will be shown in the app. Continued use of the app after changes are published constitutes acceptance of the changes.
privacy.s11Body:
For questions about our privacy policy:
Email: {{contact}}

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.s1Body: By using the CanYoldaşı app, you agree to these Terms of Service. If you do not agree, do not use the app.
terms.s2Body: CanYoldaşı is a community-driven platform for reporting and tracking stray animals in Turkey, creating and managing adoption listings, and enabling communication between animal owners.
terms.s3Body:
• You must be at least 13 years old
• You must provide accurate and up-to-date information
• You are responsible for the security of your account
• Your account cannot be transferred to another person
• Creating fake or misleading accounts is prohibited
terms.s4Body:
The following actions are prohibited:
• Creating false animal reports
• Harassment or threats toward other users
• Spam or repetitive content
• Unauthorized access attempts to other users' accounts
• Attempts to damage the app's technical infrastructure
• Automated data scraping
• Commercial advertising content (excluding listings)
terms.s5Body:
For content you upload (photos, descriptions, messages) you represent that:
• You have the right to share the relevant content
• The content does not infringe third-party rights
• The content is accurate and truthful

You grant us a limited, royalty-free license to display your content on the CanYoldaşı platform. This license terminates when you delete your account.
terms.s6Body: Boost packages are purchased through the Apple App Store or Google Play Store. Purchases are subject to the relevant store's refund policy. Refunds for digital products are at the store's discretion.
terms.s7Body: You can delete your account at any time from Account > Danger Zone > Delete Account. Account deletion removes your personal data and anonymizes your public contributions (animal reports, listings).
terms.s8Body: CanYoldaşı is not responsible for user-generated content. The app is provided "as is". No liability is accepted for damages arising from service interruptions.
terms.s9Body: When these terms are changed, a notification will be shown in the app. Continued use of the app after changes are published constitutes acceptance of the changes.
terms.s10Body: These terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of Turkey. Disputes will be resolved in Istanbul courts.
